utterances.text: And you were read the paragraph 2 in the Macedonian version and paragraph number 4 in the English version, which reads: "On 12th August at 0805 hours, the first mortar round fell in the village. It landed in the vicinity of the orthodox church in the Macedonian section of the village. Two more rounds followed, each closer to the church. All three are believed to have been 120-millimetre mortars. These are more likely to have been EAAG rounds rather than government and were the first fired into the village. Thereafter, the army fired on the Albanian side of the village with its own smaller calibre mortars." Could you tell us from what I have just read to you what is correct and what is not correct?

utterances.speaker: NIKOLCE GROZDANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: The calibre I think wasn't 120-millimetre. The calibre of the shells that were fired at us. The calibre was 82 millimetres. Later on we responded with 120 millimetres.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Everything else in this paragraph is then correct?

utterances.speaker: NIKOLCE GROZDANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes, it is correct.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreter's correction, is then correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Perhaps interpretation is not correct. Does that mean everything else then in this paragraph is correct?

utterances.speaker: NIKOLCE GROZDANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You also said that you had as a benchmark the church. This is one of the benchmarks had you in the village?

utterances.speaker: NIKOLCE GROZDANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes. It was like a benchmark but not to fire at them.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: This serves to orient you. Is this correct?

utterances.speaker: NIKOLCE GROZDANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You surely would not have made such great a mistake to aim at the Macedonian section of the village.

utterances.speaker: NIKOLCE GROZDANOVSKI [Resumed]
utterances.text: Of course.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Fine. Your answer is fine.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I have no further questions for this witness.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: That concludes the questions that will be asked of you. We thank you for your attendance here and the assistance you have been able to give. The court officer will show you from the court and you may, of course, return to your normal activities. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honours. I hope that my testimony will help you in resolving this case. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: I see three faces looking at me. I'm not sure to which to turn. Ms. Issa, is it?

utterances.speaker: MS. ISSA
utterances.text: Yes, good afternoon, Your Honour.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: The -- you're ready with the next witness, is that it.

utterances.speaker: MS. ISSA
utterances.text: It is actually Mr. Apostolski's witness but I will be cross-examining.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It is, but you're ready with your cross-examination?

utterances.speaker: MS. ISSA
utterances.text: Yes, I am.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Good. Getting too many Prosecutors. We will have the next witness at a convenient time.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Would you please read aloud the affirmation.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: The witness does not have the microphone on.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Would you please read that out aloud, please.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreters can not --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Perhaps it would be easier if I put the affirmation to you, sir. Do you affirm that the evidence you will give will be the truth, the whole truth and nothing but the truth?

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Please sit down. I would mention the witness is giving evidence with certain protective measures.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Mr. Apostolski. Now, Mr. Apostolski has some questions for you.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Good afternoon, Witness M2D-008.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can the witness, Your Honours, be given with the help of the court's usher certain lists which he has to look at and verify about his identity. Witness, could you please read the information which is on the list.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. They are correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Witness --

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: In due course, this information will be given an exhibit number under seal, Mr. Apostolski.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: The pseudonym sheet will become Exhibit 2D93, under seal, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Witness M2D-008, my name is Antonio Apostolski, and together with my colleague Jasmina Zivkovic are the Defence counsel for Mr. Johan Tarculovski. Just for your information, the Trial Chamber has approved protective measures for your testimony. Therefore, no one outside -- outside this courtroom will know your identity. Do you understand this?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I did.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Could we ask the witness to speak closer to the microphone, please. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Witness, could you please come a little bit more forward towards the microphone. Also, I would like to point out the following to you: You and I speak the same language, the Macedonian language.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: We can understand each other well, and we can go at a faster pace. But please have in mind that you have to listen to my questions carefully first, then to wait for my questions to be interpreted so that everyone in the courtroom will be able to understand what we we're talking about. Do you understand this?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I understood this.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Have you ever testified before a court of law before?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: No.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you tell us whether you have served the army?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you tell us when and where?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: In 1985 I served army in Pancevo, company for technical maintenance. I had infantry training of six months, and after six months, I enrolled the company for technical maintenance.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you have training for infantry weapons during your military service?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you get any rank in the army?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. I was lance corporal.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: When you returned from the army, you became an army reservist. Is this correct?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, it is correct.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: In which records of army reservists were you led?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: In the municipality of Cair, as a military reservist.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: In 2001, could you tell us what you did, what you worked?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can tell you that. I worked in a private company as a locksmith.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Until when did you work in that private company?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Until the middle of June.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And what happened at the middle of June?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I received an invitation from the municipality of Cair. It was given to me by a courier, and I was told to go in the military barracks of Ilinden.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And what did you do?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I responded to this summons and I went to the military barracks of Ilinden where I was given a uniform and personal weapons.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What kind of personal weapon?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I received personal weapons, an automatic rifle.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And when you were given all this, what happened then?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: One day we were introduced to the weapons that we were given and then we were sent out to the firing range where we were received training in firing.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And then, from the military barracks in Ilinden, where did you go?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: We were sent to the rest house Strahil Andasarov in the village of Ljubanci.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How did you go from the military barracks to Ljubanci?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: From the military barracks, we received transportation with trucks.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You said you were taken to the children's rest home. Where were you deployed when you got there?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I was deployed in the 1st Company, and then I was sent to the point Mecka.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Who was your superior?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I remember my superior was Jurio Marisic.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Who was in charge of all of the soldiers in the village?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Mitre Despodov.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How long were you at the Mecka position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Well, on the position of Mecka, I was deployed until the beginning of August.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And where were you deployed from this position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: From the position of Mecka, I was deployed to the position of Smok.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you describe for us the Smok position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can describe it.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Where is it?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: The position Smok is located above the village of Ljuboten.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What was the position like?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: We had one fortified bunker on the position of Smok and an observation post.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Where did you sleep in the evening?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: In the evening, we slept in the children's rest house.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you -- was the position Smok linked with some kind of telecommunication units with the children's rest house?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How was it connected?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: It was connected with wire telephone, and we used telephones in cases when our parents or somebody from the family had an emergency could reach us on that phone as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: At that time did you use any mobile phones?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: No. They were very expensive and the phones were still in some initial stage, and they were really expensive. They were about a thousand Deutschemarks and not everybody could afford them.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you have any observation devices on the Smok position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, we did.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What kind?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I had binoculars that I used, and I also used the sniper sight, the sniper binoculars.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How many persons were on a shift at the Smok position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: On the position of Smok, there were five of us.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What kind of weapons did you have when you were at the Smok position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: We had weapons, one sniper, four automatic rifles, and one machine-gun, which was always sitting on that position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How did the shifts go on the Smok position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I will tell you. The shifts were 24-hour shifts, so if today a person was working from 8.00 a.m. until 8.00 a.m. the next morning, when another shift was coming.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Do you recall, in August 2001, whether members of your company died?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. They were killed on the 10th of August near Ljubotenski Bacila.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And where were you at that time?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I was on the position Smok at the time.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you hear or see anything at that time?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. At 6.00 a.m., I was working on my duty where from Ljuboten towards the church --

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: My apologies, I'm asking you now about the 10th of August, when the soldiers died. Can you hear me?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, yes. Very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What happened on the 10th of August, 2001?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. Our soldiers were killed in Basinec, near Ljubotenski Bacila. Up there, a very loud detonation was heard.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Who told you that your soldiers had died?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: The commander Brasnarski called and said that we should be alert from -- on the position where the soldiers were killed.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Then what did you do at the Smok position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: On the Smok position, the commander Brasnarski called and said, Follow or observe attentatively [as interpreted] the access towards Ljuboten, in case there were this any terrorists moving.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you notice anything on Friday, when you were at the observation post, Smok?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. I noticed, Your Honours, from the abandoned Bacila or the sheepfold from the position of Bomba, they were firing towards the sheepfolds and four people wearing black uniforms, or black clothes, were fleeing.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did they have anything with them?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. I noticed that they were carrying weapons with them.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And what did you do from your position then?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Then, from our position, we acted with the weapons we had. From Bomba, we were firing towards the abandoned sheepfolds, and we used our guns that we were charged with.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you hit any of them when firing?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. I saw one person falling down, and the gun he had also fell down.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And what happened with the other persons?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: The others that were running away towards the village hid in the houses towards Ljuboten.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours would this be a convenient time for a break.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: If that suits you, Mr. Apostolski, yes. We are adjourn now and we will resume at 6.00.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Yes, Mr. Apostolski.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Thank you, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Witness, do you remember that before the break we were talking about the Smok position and how, on Friday, 10th of August, 2001, you saw four persons going in -- down in the direction of Ljuboten and that you fired from your position and that you shot one of them. Do you recall this?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could the witness please be shown the photograph, N005-7603.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Witness, you will be able to see the photograph on the screen very soon.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we enlarge the picture. Very well. Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Please look at this photograph carefully. Do you recognise this?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: If can't see well, you can come closer to the screen.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Can we please enlarge the picture a little bit.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we scroll the photograph to the right a little bit.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you recognise the Smok position on this photograph?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could the court usher assist the witness to mark the Smok position in 2001.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: This is a pen with which you can mark the position. Look at the photograph well and mark it.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: This is the Smok position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you now please put a number 1 next to it.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you now please draw an arrow marking the direction from which the terrorists were coming from?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can mark from which direction, but the photograph does not really show that part.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Just mark the direction, please.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: All right. This direction, towards the village.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Very well. Thank you. Can you put the number two over the line which you drew?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: They were going from higher up down towards the village?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I seek to tender this photograph into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit 2D94, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could the witness now be shown photograph 65 ter 178, N003-0425. This is fine.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you see the picture in front of you?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: If you need, please put on your glasses.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I see here clearly from this side.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you tell us from where this photograph was taken?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: This photograph was taken from the position of Smok.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Do you see anything on this photograph about which you spoke about earlier?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I remember this photograph. This is where --

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What do you see?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: This is where the abandoned sheepfolds are.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Are these the abandoned sheepfolds about which you testified that cannon fire was aimed towards them on the 10th of August?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you please mark them.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I could, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you mark, or do you see on this photograph the direction from which the terrorists were moving, terrorists which you shot at?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you do this with a line, please.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you put a number 1 above the circle which you marked, the circle marking the sheepfold?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And can you put a number 2 above the line marking the direction in which the terrorists were fleeing?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And can you also, with an arrow, in blue, this is a different pen that you will be given, to mark of the direction of the village of Ljuboten?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can mark it.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Now the pen will give you a blue colour.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: This is where the village is.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Just show the direction, please.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: This is the direction where they were fleeing to.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Mark it, please.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: THE INTERPRETER
utterances.text: Interpreters kindly ask that pause be maintained between questions and answers.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you place above the red line the number 2?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, okay.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And next to the blue line the number 3.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] This may cause a little bit of a confusion. Perhaps the court usher can assist in erasing these two numbers.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: All right.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And the other one as well. In the red you marked the line from where the terrorists were fleeing?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Now, please, under the blue line, the direction of Ljuboten, place the number 3 there.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Thank you.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: You're welcome.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I seek to tender this photograph into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit 2D95, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Witness, could you tell us whether, on Friday afternoon, you noticed anything in the Ljuboten village? This is Friday, the 10th of August, the day when the soldiers died.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. I remember there were shooting from the village towards our position of Smok from the Dolno Maalo where -- and also from the area of the mosque from the houses there. They were activities against us. And, also, from the Rastanski Pat in the houses, there were shots fired from that locations as well.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What did they fire with?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: They fired with sniper guns and from the houses on Rastanski Pat they fired with machine-guns, and below the mosque there were also shootings from machine-guns.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: As for Dolno Maalo, how do you know that this was a sniper shooting?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: That position was very hard to detect because they were really precise in targeting us on the Smok position, but we discovered the sparks of the sniper.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you discover this in any other way and did you do anything at your position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: According to the shooting, which was so precise and accurate, as well as the sparks, we could tell it was a sniper.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you fire towards these places?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, with the weapons that we had at the point.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Which weapons did you have and you used?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: We fired with the sniper, with the automatic rifles, with the machine-guns that was constantly on that position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did the army use any other weapons on that Friday afternoon?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: It's a long time since, and I cannot really remember, Your Honours. There were shootings from Bomba position with a cannon and with the weapons they had.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you tell us where you were on that Friday evening?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can tell you. I was on the position of Smok.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you notice anything that Friday evening at the Smok position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. We notice a mass moving of the villagers towards Skopje, towards Radisani.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Where did you spend that whole of Friday night?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I spent it very hard. I was on the position of Smok. I couldn't sleep. I was really overburdened with thoughts. I was sleeping like on a tip-toes. I was really hurt with the tragedy that day.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you tell us where you were on Saturday morning?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can tell you.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: This is Saturday, the 11th.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I asked my commander, Mario Jurisic, because we had that incident where soldiers were killed, soldiers from my company, I asked him if I could attend the funeral.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Very well. Did the major allow to you go?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, he allowed it. I asked my commander, because it was our practice to ask the -- your superior officer, and I asked him, and he let me go to the funeral.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And the whole day of Saturday you were at the funeral. What did you do there?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I spent the whole day at the funeral. I was in the dining-room in the village of Ljuboten, because the people who came to pay their respect to the soldiers that were killed were then put in the dining-room, you know, we the Christians have the custom to eat on the funeral and to pay tribute.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And after? After the funeral, where did you go? Where did you go after the funeral?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: After the funeral, I went home to see my family for a brief ten minutes, and then I went back to the position of Smok.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And the night -- this is the whole night, Saturday towards Sunday, you were there the whole night?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, that was the shift. I spent the whole night on the position of Smok.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Where were you on that Sunday morning? What did you do at the Smok position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: On the position of Smok on the morning, I was on duty from 6.00 till 8.00, and I noticed one event. From Dolno Maalo, I mean from the area of the church towards the houses, Your Honours, I detected shootings from automatic rifles from several positions.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How did you know that this was where the shooting came from?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I noticed the shootings from the flames they release when shots are fired.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: When you say "fire," this is the light of the gun when fired. Is this what you had in mind?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, that's exactly what I had in mind.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: From how many places did you notice that this was happening?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I noticed several places in the houses where the shots were fired from the weapons they used.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You mentioned Macedonian houses.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: This is the area from Ljubanci towards our position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did -- was there any superior at the position at that time?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, there was. I remember distinctly Captain Nikola came.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did he come by himself?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: He came with several soldiers.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And what did the captain say when he came?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: He was my superior, and he had a higher rank; so he deployed me, and he told me to be very careful.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And what did you notice once the captain came?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I noticed three detonations towards the Macedonian houses from the area of Ljubanci.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you return this fire?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, we did. Our position was also fired at, and we responded with the weapons that we had. And those locations that we noticed - Your Honours, I have to speak the truth - we used mortar against the positions that we had noticed.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could the witness please be shown photograph 65 ter 178, N003-0375.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You said that you saw shootings on Sunday morning from the houses behind -- below the church. Do you recall this?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I recall.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I gave the wrong number. 65 ter, this is 178, N003-0374.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Do you see the picture in front of you?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you tell me where was this picture taken from?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can see where this was taken from. From the Smok position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Do you see the church?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I do see the church.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you mark with a circle the church.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Please put number 1 to the church.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Do you see on this photograph the houses that you were talking about, that this is where the shootings came from?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I see them.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Can you please mark them with number 2. Please first circle them.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Now put number 2.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You said that you also heard three strong detonations.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you circle them?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Your Honours, from here, I cannot do this because I was transferred in my positions. Therefore, I cannot mark this area with certainty.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You cannot mark them on this photograph, can you?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: No, I cannot.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I seek to tender this photograph into evidence, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit 2D96, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: On the 12th of August, 2001, were your positions shot at from other positions in the village? Did you notice anything?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. I noticed, I noticed well. There was shooting from Dolno Maalo and from the mosque, the houses below the mosque, and from the area towards the Rastak road and the houses there.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you notice what kind of weapons they used? Could you tell me what weapons they used in Dolno Maalo?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: They used machine-guns, snipers towards our positions, but it was very difficult to detect the person using the sniper.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How did you detect the sniper that was shooting at you?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: As I said, this was very difficult to do. We put a helmet to see from what side he was shooting. So we discovered this position. That he was shooting at us directly from the area of Dolno Maalo.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What happened with the helmet because you said you put a helmet?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: We placed the helmet on a rock, and the other group was charged to scout and see where the shooting was coming from more precisely, and the helmet that we placed on the rock was hit on that position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: So somebody was very precise in shooting?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Most probably it is not possible to do so with a different kind of weapon, to shoot so precisely.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could the witness please be shown 65 ter 178, N003-0371.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you tell me where was this photograph taken from? Can you tell?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. This is from our position. This photograph was taken from our position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: From the position of Smok, right?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Do you see on this photograph Dolno Maalo from where you said the sniper was shooting?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. Just now I've located this region. This is towards the river. This was Dolno Maalo, as I can see from this picture.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you circle the place where you saw the sniper shooting?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. Right here, from these houses, exactly. Towards our position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Would you please put number 1 next to the circle.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I can.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You said something about a location below the mosque.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. I now remember.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Do you see that?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. And I can locate it. This house -- also the house in this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Would you please mark it?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I will, Your Honours. It is right here, right below the mosque. Right in this area.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you put number 2 next to the circle.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: [Marks]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Thank you. Do you also see some other position from where your positions were shot at?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I see also another position, but I don't see the house, Rastankski house. I see the cemetery, and there was fire from there too.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What kind of weapons were used?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I believe that a sniper was used. Yes, Your Honours. I think that snipers and mortars were also used.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How do you know that the mortar was used?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: On that day, about 30 metres from our position and the commander Brasnarski detected this location from where they were firing at us with mortars, and I think this was the position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you mark it?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can. From this place, the cemetery.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you put number 3, please?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And did you see that mortar was used or were you told?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I'm not a military expert, Your Honours. I believe, since this fell somewhere in the area towards our point, about 30 metres from our point, or -- and towards Bomba.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What fell near your bunker?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: A shell, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you see flames or fire from the circle that you marked with number 3?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I cannot say that I really saw any fire. From the upper position Bomba, they saw that this was the location that was being shot at, that this was the location from where our position was being shot at.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How was the position Bomba with your position Smok connected?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: There was a trench, a channel -- a trench dug from our position towards Bomba.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could that trench be used for going from one position to the other?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, this was possible. Because this was a protected position and the goal was to detect other positions, other targets.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you have any other communication between the two positions?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, we did. As I mentioned in the statement, we had wire links, telephone. This is from the army of Macedonia.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Very well.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I seek to tender this photograph into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit 2D97, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You said that there were shots from the Rastak, right?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, from several houses, but I cannot see them on this photograph.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Which weapons were used against your position? Which weapons were used in the position of Rastak?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Machine-gun. At least this is what I remember, from several locations, from the houses. I cannot exactly see this on the photograph. It's not very clear to me.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How did you see that there was a machine-gun?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: You can notice this. The barrage shooting of the machine-gun towards our position, the bullets, we were very cautious in that. I believe it was machine-gun that was used. And the lights, the sparks which the machine-gun emitted.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Where was the machine-gun located?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: In the houses. In one house towards the chimney. In the other houses, they were others who were shooting. Some from the balconies.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could the witness please be shown ERN 003-368.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you tell me where is this picture taken from?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can tell you, Your Honours. Again, from our positions. This is the photograph made from our position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: From the Smok position?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Do you see on this photograph the houses that is the positions from where shots were fired at your positions?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I see the houses. This photograph is of somewhat older date.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you please circle them?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I could, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: These are the houses that shot fire at your positions.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, these are the houses. I circled the houses from where shots came that morning.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Do you see any other position that was firing at you from Rastanski?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, a house.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Is there any other house --

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, this house. This is the house. Because there were some older -- this seems to be an older photograph because behind it there were some nylon coverings.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: That house that you just circled, which weapons did they use?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: They used machine-guns behind the roof without shingles.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Would you please mark that house with number 2 where the shootings came from the roof tiles?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Please explain how were they firing under the roof -- from under the roof.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: A number of tiles, the shingles were taken out from the chimney facing our position. There were two chimneys, so, yes, this is the house. A number of shingles were taken out, and it was from there that we established that they were shooting at us.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What were you doing?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: From my position, we used the weapons which we had towards these positions. Yes, this is so.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Which weapon did you use?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: With the machine-gun and the weapons that we had at our position.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You personally, which weapon did you use?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I used a machine-gun towards this position, I think. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you put number 1 to the houses that you circled.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Was other weapon used against these houses, did the army use other weapon?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, with mortars too. These are the positions that were firing at us. Yes, I think this was so. It is so.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: You said that some shells landed near your position, and you took shelter. What kind of shells fell on your position, Smok?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: They fell right below us. I believe this was a mortar shell, whether from the upper side, I'm not an expert to say, I'm not a military expert, so to say precisely from where this was shot --

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What did you do?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I heard the captain, Captain Nikola, saying that we should take shelter in our fortified positions.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I seek to tender this photograph into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit 2D98, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: In the village of Ljuboten, from the position up there, did you see members of the Macedonian security forces?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I saw. That was the morning, sometime around 8.00. 8.00, 8.30, 9.00, around this time. I think it was closer to 9.00. Yes.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How did they move?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I see this photograph --

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could the witness please have the photography moved.

utterances.speaker: THE WITNESS
utterances.text: [Interpretation] I think we're mixing things up.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Where did you see them at around 9.00?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I don't see the picture now. This was by the cemetery. This was by the area of the church.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could the photograph be removed from the screen, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: At around 9.00, you saw the Macedonian security forces around the church, right?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, this is right. It was at that time.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you shoot from your positions when you saw them?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: No, we did not shoot. They were our security forces. We did not shoot.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Later in the day, did you see movement of Macedonian security forces? Later, not in the morning.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Around 11.30, 11.00, I can't tell you precisely. I can recall I was very excited at that time. I was under great stress, what we saw.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Where did you notice them.

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Towards the houses of Rastak.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How were they moving?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: They were moving very slowly because there was fire towards our position but also towards them being opened.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you see any vehicle of the Macedonian security forces in the village?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. Yes, Your Honours. I did see a vehicle, a military vehicle. I know it was a dark one. Behind it there were members of our security forces that were moving slowly.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: So the vehicle was in front and behind the vehicle were the people, right?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, this is what I'm remembering now.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: How were they moving?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: It was very stressful. It was slow. These places which I have been mentioning and pointing on the photographs, there was fire being shot at them. Therefore, they were moving very, very slowly.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did that vehicle come closer to the houses that you marked?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: As far as I can recall now, I believe not there.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did it arrive near the houses?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: It was in the vicinity. It was around the houses.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And when that vehicle arrived up to that point, did you notice anything?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. I noticed in the part of the house which I marked that they were fleeing, five, six, persons, five, I believe, in black uniforms towards the area of the Ljuboten mountain. This is the direction in which they were fleeing.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And did you see, were they wearing -- carrying anything?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes. We were firing in the direction that they were fleeing. One of them fell down, and I saw his weapon. And those fleeing upward, I just saw the person who fell down and I saw that he had a weapon in his arm. I cannot exactly look very carefully, but the person that did I saw fall, he fell with his weapon.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you shoot from your positions?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, we were shooting from our positions and from Bomba. We fired towards them, and then I saw when this person fell, and I noted the weapon; I noted that the weapon dropped from his hand.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Did you notice how many persons fled towards the mountain?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Five. There were five. Whether someone else had fallen, I don't know. I know that two had escaped in the mountain.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Could we have, again, 2D98 on the screen, please.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Do you see on this photograph the house?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I marked this house. This is house number 2.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Could you please mark it in blue in which direction these people wearing black clothes were going to?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Yes, I can mark it. One cannot really the forest going upward, but this was the general area.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Please connect the blue arrow with the house number 2?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: And there was the downhill slope going towards the house.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Down below is not a flat field, is it?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: No, there was a downhill slope. This was uphill and downhill, so one couldn't really locate them well.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: What time of the day was that?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: Sometime in the afternoon.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: And afterwards, were there any shots in the village?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: No, I don't know what else to say. There was no firing.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Until what time did you stay in the position of Smok on the Sunday?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: I stayed until my replacement shift came, until 8.00. I was tired, under stress, and I returned to the children's rest house.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honour, I seek to tender this photograph into evidence.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: It will be received.

utterances.speaker: THE REGISTRAR
utterances.text: As Exhibit 2D99, Your Honours.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation]

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: Which weapon did you use against those persons that were fleeing?

utterances.speaker: WITNESS M2D-008
utterances.text: With our personal weapons, which I mentioned. I don't know whether you understood me. There were people from the 2nd Company here too, so also shots were fired from the position higher than we were, from Bomba and above Bomba everybody was in combat readiness that day.

utterances.speaker: MR. APOSTOLSKI
utterances.text: [Interpretation] Your Honours, I have no further questions for this witness, so I believe this is the convenient time for recess.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
utterances.text: Thank you, Mr. Apostolski, that is a convenient time. We must adjourn now, and we must ask you to return again tomorrow, sir. We will commence again tomorrow at 2.15. I suspect there is every likelihood that we will conclude before 6.00 tomorrow. If that is so, we will try to manage just two sessions, each of an hour and a half or a little more. I indicate that so that counsel can try and adjust their timing. But if we have to go to a third session we lose another half-hour with the break, and it's better to do two full-sessions if it's likely that we can finish. And that appears to be the case. We adjourn until 2.15 tomorrow.

utterances.speaker: JUDGE PARKER
